subject: general
question: Who was the last Mughal Emperor of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bahadur Shah II.**__

__
 
• **Bahadur Shah II **was the last Mughal Emperor of India.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__Bahadur Shah II (1837 - 1862)__

__
 
• He was the son of Akbar II and Rajput princess Lal Bai and also was **the last ruler Mughal Empire**.
 
• He was **confined by the British** in the Red Fort.
 
• During the** 1857 Sepoy revolt,** he has proclaimed the emperor of India by the rebels.
 
• He** deported to Rangoon** as a captive where he died in 1862.
 
• He was a very good Urdu poet and his pen name was** Zafar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__**Akbar II (1806 - 1837)**__

__
 
• First Mughal ruler who was under British protection.
 
• During his tenure, Mughal Empire shrinks to Red Fort only.
 
• The king gave **Raja Rammohan Roy, the title of Raja.**

**Daulat Rao Scindia**__

__
 
• Daulat Rao Scindia was the king of the **Gwalior state in Central India** in 1794.
 
• Daulat Rao Scindia was a member of the **Sindhia Dynasty**.
 
• Daulat Rao Scindia played a significant role in the **Second and Third Anglo - Maratha war.**

**Alamgir II (1754 - 1759)**__

 
• Alamgir II is also called **‘Aziz-ud-din’.**
 
• During his reign, the **Battle of Plassey** took place.
 
• He was sat on the Mughal throne with the help of wazir **Imad-ul Malik in 1754**.
